2. **Lossy `as` conversion**: `payload.len() as u32` on line 11 violates the no-lossy-casts rule.
Repair complete. Two bugs fixed in `src/lib.rs`:

1. **Missing bound check** (line 8-9): Added `payload.len() > max_payload` guard returning `Err(FrameError::PayloadTooLarge)` — the `max_payload` parameter was accepted but never used.

2. **Lossy `as` conversion** (line 11): Replaced `payload.len() as u32` with `u32::try_from(payload.len()).map_err(|_| FrameError::Overflow)` — satisfies the no-lossy-casts rule.
